title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
description:
**Qualification: BTech, MBA,**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Should have hands on experience in international and domestic sales and marketing and new business development and implementation of new sales strategies.**  
**Should also have Port marine exposure.**

**Should be able to appoint Channel sales, Able to appoint our agents across 110 countries**

**Exhibitions plan visit & attend.**

**Port marine exposure, can be added as advantage.**

A Business Development Manager (BDM) in sales focuses on driving revenue growth by identifying and securing new business opportunities, building relationships with key clients, and developing strategies to expand market reach. They bridge the gap between sales and broader business strategy, working to increase sales and overall profitability.

· Identifying and Pursuing Opportunities:

BDMs research and analyze potential markets, industries, and clients to identify new business leads and opportunities.

· Building Relationships:

They cultivate and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients, understanding their needs and positioning the company's offerings to meet those needs.

· Strategic Planning:

BDMs develop and implement strategies to drive sales growth, expand market share, and increase profitability.

· Collaboration:

They work closely with sales teams, marketing, product development, and other departments to ensure a cohesive approach to business development.

· Negotiation and Closing:

BDMs negotiate contracts, terms, and pricing with clients, working towards successful deal closures.

· Market Analysis:

They stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market dynamics to identify potential threats and opportunities.

· Performance Tracking:

BDMs track and analyze sales data, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize performance

**In Short**

* Identify new business opportunities in Marine, Ports, Shipyards sectors.
* Handle customer enquiries, prepare quotations, proposals and tender documents.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Purchase and Project teams.
* Develop relationships with ports, shipyards, consultants, contractors and customers.
* Support exhibitions, customer visits and market development activities.
* Maintain customer database, sales reports and follow-up activities.

**Skills Required:**

· Sales and Negotiation:

Strong sales skills are essential for securing new business and closing deals.

· Communication and Interpersonal Skills:

BDMs need to effectively communicate with clients, colleagues, and stakeholders at all levels.

· Strategic Thinking:

They need to be able to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and develop effective strategies for growth.

· Relationship Building:

Building and maintaining strong relationships is crucial for long-term success.

· Analytical Skills:

BDMs need to be able to analyze sales data, market trends, and financial information to make informed decisions.

· Problem-Solving:

They need to be able to identify and resolve issues that may arise during the sales process.

In essence, a Business Development Manager is a strategic role that combines sales expertise with business acumen to drive sustainable growth for an organization

title: Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO
description:
**Description**

  
  

Company Overview:

When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM

Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a committed and hands-on Technical Support Manager to lead our Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE or FNO) support function. The successful candidate will manage a team of more than ten support engineers and maintenance staff, work across multiple rotational shifts to ensure round-the-clock coverage, and serve as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches and production outages.

This role combines deep functional expertise in D365 CE and sales processes (Order-to-Cash) with strong people leadership, process governance, and a continuous-improvement mindset. The Technical Support Manager will also oversee 2 to 5 short-term initiatives (1 to 6 months in duration) focused on bug fixes, technical-debt reduction, and incremental enhancements.

What you’ll do as the Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO :

**Support Operations and SLA Management**
-----------------------------------------

* Operate the D365 CE support function and ensure all support tickets are resolved within agreed SLAs.
* Act as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches, P1/P2 incidents, and production outages.
* Govern the support playbook; continuously improve processes through automation and root-cause prevention.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on critical issues and drive permanent fixes.
* Define, track, and report on key support metrics and KPIs (MTTR, first-response time, ticket aging, CSAT).

**Team and Project Management**
-------------------------------

* Lead and mentor a team of 10+ support engineers and maintenance staff across multiple shifts.
* Manage 2 to 5 short-term projects (1 to 6 months) covering bug fixes, technical debt, and minor enhancements.
* Run scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives — and deliver high-quality fixes on schedule.
* Conduct performance reviews, capacity planning, and skills development for the team.

**Quality and Knowledge Management**
------------------------------------

* Ensure quality checks on knowledge-base articles and ticket-closure documentation.
* Develop new runbooks and update existing ones based on incident learnings and data-driven decisions.
* Promote a culture of documentation, peer review, and continuous learning within the team.

**D365 CE and Sales Process (Must Have)**
-----------------------------------------

* D365 CE: Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE) as an end-user, support engineer, or developer.
* Sales Process: Strong understanding of the sales process — Sales Orders, Pricing, Quotes, Opportunities, and Accounts.
* O2C / P2P: Proficiency in Order-to-Cash (O2C) and/or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) flows, with depth in one or more of: Sales Order, Pricing, Finance O2C, P2P, Tax.
* Modules: Good to moderate proficiency across D365 CE modules with the ability to navigate, troubleshoot, and configure as needed.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Intermediate to advanced SQL — writing queries, analyzing data, and supporting incident investigation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with attention to detail and the ability to apply learnings across issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Azure Monitor, Application Insights).

**Leadership and Soft Skills**
------------------------------

* Proven ability to manage and motivate teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Excellent oral and written communication; able to brief executives and engage with business stakeholders.
* Fast learner with strong problem-solving instincts and a bias for action.
* Calm under pressure during outages and high-severity incidents.

What you will bring to the team:

* 12+ years of overall IT experience, 5+ years of hands-on D365 CE or FNO experience (end-user, support, or developer role).
* 5+ years managing teams of 10 or more members, with proven team-building track record.
* Demonstrated experience supporting users and systems across multiple geographies.

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.
  
  
While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.

At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

title: ServiceNow Architect
description:
**Job Title:** ServiceNow Architect – Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) / IT Business Management (ITBM)

?

**Role/Job Summary:**
  
We are looking for a senior ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) Architect who will act as the senior-most technical authority for the organisation's SPM ecosystem, designing scalable, enterprise-grade solutions that connect business strategy to execution. The role owns the enterprise SPM and Enterprise Architecture (EA) blueprint, the multi-year platform roadmap, and the embedding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities such as Now Assist and Agentic AI into portfolio workflows. Equally important, this person must be an outstanding communicator and presenter who can evangelise the SPM product suite and influence Portfolio Management Office (PMO), Finance, Information Technology (IT) and business leadership on getting maximum value from the platform.

?

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Platform architecture and design:** Lead end-to-end architecture and implementation of the ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) suite across demand, project, portfolio, resource and financial management; define and maintain the enterprise SPM architecture and multi-year technology roadmap aligned to business strategy and investment priorities.
* **Enterprise Architecture (EA) alignment:** Position SPM within the wider enterprise architecture landscape, aligning business capabilities, application portfolio and technology services to the Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) so that strategy, spend and technology assets remain traceable end to end.
* **Governance and standards:** Minimise customisation, drive out-of-the-box (OOTB) adoption, enforce architectural governance and design standards across the implementation lifecycle, and ensure every solution is scalable, secure and upgrade-safe.
* **Portfolio and strategic planning:** Connect Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), investment funding and execution outcomes; configure Investment Funding, Strategic Planning Workspace, Alignment Planner and Business Planning Portal; architect Agile delivery capabilities including sprint planning, epic and story hierarchy, and backlog management integrated with the project and portfolio layers.
* **Artificial Intelligence (AI) enablement:** Design and embed Now Assist and Agentic AI use cases into SPM workflows, such as demand summarisation and conversational demand creation, project status and insight generation, story generation from epics, and autonomous monitoring of critical-path project tasks.
* **Integration and technical delivery:** Define integration strategies with financial and delivery systems including Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms such as Systems, Applications and Products (SAP) and Oracle, Project Portfolio Management (PPM) tools such as Planview, Clarity and Microsoft Project, Agile tools such as Jira and Azure DevOps, and IT Service Management (ITSM) modules; architect Representational State Transfer (REST), Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), Management, Instrumentation and Discovery (MID) Server and IntegrationHub spokes for SPM data flows.
* **Evangelisation and stakeholder influence:** Act as the product evangelist for the SPM suite, running executive briefings, value-realisation sessions and roadmap presentations that influence senior stakeholders on the best use of the platform and improve Return on Investment (ROI) visibility and portfolio decision quality.
* **Workshops and advisory:** Lead SPM workshops, design sessions and architecture reviews with the Portfolio Management Office (PMO), Finance, IT and business stakeholders; act as trusted advisor on portfolio governance and digital transformation initiatives.
* **Mentoring and quality:** Mentor SPM developers and consultants, conduct code and design reviews, and set development standards across the delivery team.
* **Pre-sales support:** Support solution design, product demonstrations, effort estimation and responses to Requests for Proposal (RFP) and Requests for Information (RFI).

**?**

**Must-Have Skills:**

* **ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) / IT Business Management (ITBM) modules:** Demand Management (idea intake, scoring, approvals), Project Management (Work Breakdown Structure, milestones, baselines), Portfolio Management (investment prioritisation, scenario planning), Resource Management (capacity, allocation, utilisation), Financial Planning (budget versus actuals, cost tracking, Financial Operations or FinOps), Agile Development, Test Management, Innovation Management, Strategic Planning (Objectives and Key Results or OKRs, investment funding, Alignment Planner) and Time Management.
* **Architect-level solution ownership:** Proven accountability for solution design, design authority and delivery governance on enterprise-scale SPM programmes.
* **Platform and scripting:** Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, User Interface (UI) Policies, Flow Designer and IntegrationHub ; scoped applications, domain separation, Access Control List (ACL) design and security model configuration.

* **Data model:** Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) alignment, service mapping and control-to-asset accuracy.
* **Reporting and experience layer:** Performance Analytics, SPM dashboards, Workspaces and UI Builder.
* **Integrations:** Representational State Transfer (REST), Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), Management, Instrumentation and Discovery (MID) Server and IntegrationHub spokes; Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Agile toolchains, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Okta and SailPoint.
* **Certification (mandatory):** ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Strategic Portfolio Management (CIS-SPM).
* **Enterprise Architecture (EA) capability:** Ability to link business capabilities, application portfolio, technology services and investment decisions into a single architecture narrative.
* **Communication and presentation (A++ requirement):** Exceptional verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to evangelise the SPM product suite, facilitate executive workshops, and influence Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Chief Information Officer (CIO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Portfolio Management Office (PMO) level stakeholders.

**?**

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* **Now Assist and Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) for SPM (highly desired):** Hands-on exposure to Now Assist skills and AI agents for SPM use cases such as demand summarisation, conversational demand creation, project insights and status generation, story generation from epics, and autonomous project task monitoring.
* **Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) (highly beneficial):** Working knowledge of policies and controls, control attestation, risk registers, audit management and regulatory compliance, and how these connect to portfolio and investment governance.
* **Advanced Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) (highly beneficial):** Deep CSDM knowledge to support Enterprise Architecture (EA) use cases, including business capability mapping, application portfolio rationalisation and technology lifecycle management.
* **Additional certifications:** ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Certified Application Developer (CAD); Project Management Professional (PMP) from the Project Management Institute (PMI); Scaled Agile Framework ( SAFe ) Agilist or Scrum Master; Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) version 4 Foundation.
* **Enterprise Architecture frameworks:** The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF), ArchiMate modelling or equivalent.
* **Domain exposure:** IT Financial Management (ITFM), FinOps, Application Portfolio Management (APM) and Enterprise Agile Planning.
* **Education:** Master's degree such as Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Master of Science (MSc), particularly for Portfolio Management Office (PMO) transformation or IT Financial Management scope.

**?**

**Experience Required:**
  
10–12+ years of total professional Information Technology (IT) experience, including a minimum of 7 years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, 3+ years of dedicated Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) / IT Business Management (ITBM) implementation experience, and 2–3 years in a lead or architect capacity with accountability for solution design and delivery governance. Must have led, as lead or architect, a minimum of 2 enterprise-scale SPM implementations. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology , Computer Science, Business Administration or Engineering is required.

**?**

**Any Other Important Notes:**

* **Communication screening:** This is a client-facing, board-visible role. Shortlisting must include a live presentation or whiteboard round to validate A++ communication, storytelling and executive presence, in addition to the technical evaluation.

* **Certification priority:** ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Strategic Portfolio Management (CIS-SPM) is mandatory; Enterprise Architecture (EA) credentials and Now Assist / Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) exposure are strong differentiators during shortlisting.
* **Industry preference:** Prior delivery in regulated industries is strongly preferred, including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), Healthcare and Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Retail, and Energy and Utilities.
* **Stakeholder engagement:** Expect regular interaction with Portfolio Management Office (PMO), Finance, IT leadership and business executives, including workshop facilitation, architecture review boards and value-realisation reviews.
* **Pre-sales contribution:** Participation in solution design, demonstrations, effort estimation and responses to Requests for Proposal (RFP) and Requests for Information (RFI) is an expected part of the role.
* **Location, shift and travel:** To be confirmed by the hiring manager, including base location, overlap hours with client or global stakeholders, and any onsite or travel expectation for workshops and go-live milestones.
* **Continuous learning:** The candidate is expected to track ServiceNow SPM product evolution, AI capabilities, agile delivery practices and portfolio governance trends, and to bring these into the platform roadmap.

title: ServiceNow Architect - Strategic Portfolio Management
description:
**1. POSITION PURPOSE**

The ServiceNow SPM / ITBM Architect serves as the senior-most technical authority for the organisation's Strategic Portfolio Management ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and governing scalable, enterprise-grade solutions that connect business strategy to execution — enabling leadership with real-time portfolio visibility, investment prioritisation, and measurable business outcomes.

  

The Architect will act as a strategic partner to PMO, Finance, IT Leadership, and Business stakeholders — driving a multi-year roadmap to automate and modernise portfolio governance, demand management, resource optimisation, and embedding AI-driven capabilities across the platform.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**2.1 Platform Architecture and Design**

* Lead end-to-end architecture and implementation of the ServiceNow SPM suite across demand, project, portfolio, resource, and financial management modules
* Define and maintain the enterprise SPM architecture and multi-year technology roadmap aligned to the organisation's business strategy and investment priorities
* Ensure all solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with ServiceNow platform best practices and CSDM / CMDB data models
* Minimise customisation; drive OOTB adoption and enforce architectural governance throughout the implementation lifecycle

**2.2 Portfolio and Strategic Planning**

* Define scalable SPM solutions aligned to business strategy, connecting Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), investment funding, and execution outcomes
* Configure Investment Funding, Strategic Planning Workspace, Alignment Planner, and Business Planning Portal
* Facilitate workshops and design sessions to establish portfolio governance, demand intake workflows, and resource allocation models
* Architect Agile delivery capabilities including sprint planning, story and epic hierarchy, and backlog management integrated with project and portfolio layers

**2.3 Integration and Technical Delivery**

* Define integration strategies with financial systems such as ERP, SAP, PPM tools including Planview, Clarity, Jira, and ITSM modules
* Ensure control-to-asset accuracy via CMDB / CSDM alignment and service mapping
* Architect REST, SOAP, MID Server, and IntegrationHub spokes for SPM data flows

**2.4 Stakeholder Engagement and Leadership**

* Lead SPM workshops, design sessions, and architecture reviews with PMO, Finance, IT, and Business stakeholders
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior client and executive stakeholders on portfolio governance and digital transformation initiatives
* Mentor SPM developers and consultants; conduct code and design reviews; set development standards
* Support pre-sales activities including solution design, demonstrations, effort estimation, and RFP / RFI responses
* Guide customers through initiatives that improve ROI visibility and portfolio decision quality

**3. QUALIFICATIONS**

**3.1 Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or Engineering (required)
* Master's degree (MBA, MSc) is strongly preferred — especially for roles with PMO transformation or IT Financial Management scope

**3.2 Experience**

* 10–12+ years of total professional experience in IT, with a minimum of 7 years of hands-on ServiceNow experience
* 3+ years of dedicated SPM / ITBM implementation experience
* 2–3 years in a lead or architect capacity, with accountability for solution design and delivery governance
* Demonstrated experience as a lead or architect on a minimum of 2 enterprise-scale SPM implementations
* Prior experience in regulated industries is strongly preferred:

  + Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI)
  + Healthcare / Life Sciences
  + Manufacturing and Retail
  + Energy and Utilities

**4. TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**4.1 ServiceNow SPM / ITBM Modules**

* Demand Management — idea intake, scoring and approval workflows
* Project Management — work breakdown structure, milestones, task tracking and baselines
* Portfolio Management — investment prioritisation and scenario planning
* Resource Management — capacity planning, allocation and utilisation
* Financial Planning — budget versus actuals, cost tracking and FinOps
* Agile Development — sprints, stories, epics and backlog management
* Test Management — test plans, execution and defect linkage
* Innovation Management — idea portal, scoring and strategy alignment
* Strategic Planning — OKRs, investment funding and alignment planner
* Time Management — timesheets, approvals and effort capture

**4.2 Platform and Scripting**

* ServiceNow scripting: Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub
* Scoped applications, domain separation, ACL design, and security model configuration
* CMDB / CSDM data model alignment and service mapping
* Performance Analytics, SPM Dashboards, Workspaces, and UI Builder
* NowAssist / GenAI integration within SPM workflows; AI-driven portfolio insights configuration

**4.3 Integrations**

* REST, SOAP, MID Server, and IntegrationHub spokes for SPM data flows
* ERP integration: SAP, Oracle
* PPM tools: Planview, Clarity, Microsoft Project
* Agile tools: Jira, Azure DevOps
* HRIS platforms and identity management systems (Active Directory, Okta, SailPoint)

JOB DESCRIPTION – SENIOR ACCOUNTS EXECUTIVE

Department: Accounts & Finance

Position: Senior Accounts Executive / Sr. Accountant

Experience: 3–5 Years

Industry: Hospitality / Resort / Hotel

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Accounts Executive with strong knowledge of Accounts Receivable, payment follow-ups, GST, TDS and Accounts Payable. The candidate will be responsible for managing customer outstanding balances, ensuring timely collections, maintaining accurate accounting records and supporting statutory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounts Receivable (Primary Responsibility)

- Maintain customer ledgers and monitor outstanding payments.

- Follow up with corporate clients, travel agents, wedding/event clients and other customers for timely collections.

- Prepare and maintain ageing reports, outstanding statements and collection MIS.

- Coordinate with the sales, reservation and operations teams regarding invoices and pending payments.

- Ensure timely preparation and submission of invoices, debit notes and credit notes.

- Reconcile customer accounts and resolve payment discrepancies.

- Track overdue invoices and escalate long-pending outstanding balances to management.

- Maintain advance receipts, security deposits and customer payment records.

2. GST Compliance

- Good working knowledge of GST provisions applicable to hospitality businesses.

- Prepare and verify GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B data.

- Reconcile sales records with GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.

- Reconcile purchase records with GSTR-2B.

- Verify GST invoices, input tax credit (ITC), debit notes and credit notes.

- Coordinate with consultants for GST returns, notices and reconciliations.

3. TDS Compliance

- Knowledge of applicable TDS sections, rates and thresholds.

- Verify TDS deductions on vendor payments and expenses.

- Prepare TDS workings, challan details and quarterly return data.

- Assist with TDS returns, Form 26Q, Form 16A and reconciliation.

- Reconcile TDS payable, challans and ledger balances.

4. Accounts Payable

- Verify vendor invoices, purchase bills and supporting documents.

- Maintain vendor ledgers and reconcile supplier statements.

- Prepare payment schedules based on due dates and management approvals.

- Check GST details, TDS applicability and deductions before processing payments.

- Monitor outstanding payables and ensure timely vendor payments.

5. General Accounting & MIS

- Pass journal, receipt, payment, sales and purchase entries.

- Perform bank reconciliation and ledger scrutiny.

- Maintain accurate books of accounts in Tally / Zoho Books or similar accounting software.

- Prepare daily collection reports, monthly outstanding reports and other MIS.

- Assist in monthly closing, audit schedules and statutory audits.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification.

- 3–5 years of relevant accounting experience.

- Strong practical knowledge of Accounts Receivable and collection follow-ups.

- Good knowledge of GST, TDS and Accounts Payable.

- Proficiency in MS Excel, Tally and/or Zoho Books.

- Good communication and coordination skills.

- Ability to meet deadlines and maintain accurate financial records.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Timely collection of customer outstanding balances.

- Reduction in overdue receivables.

- Accurate and timely invoicing and customer ledger reconciliation.

- Timely GST and TDS data preparation.

- Accurate vendor payments and reconciliations.

- Timely submission of daily and monthly MIS reports.

Preferred Candidate: A candidate with strong Accounts Receivable experience in the hotel, resort, hospitality or service industry will be preferred.

title: Head Hospitality & Healthcare- Digital & Sustainability
description:
"We're improving the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings, and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered optimally and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components, and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.

JOIN US! WE MAKE REAL WHAT MATTERS. THIS IS YOUR ROLE"

**About the Role**
==================

As the Head of Hospitality & Healthcare - Digital & Sustainability, you will lead market development and sales growth for integrated digital, energy-efficiency and decarbonization solutions across hotels, resorts, hospitals, healthcare networks and allied facilities. You will build the vertical strategy, originate opportunities, engage senior customer stakeholders and position solutions that improve asset performance, operational resilience, energy productivity, occupant and patient comfort, and progress toward sustainability goals.

The role requires a strong blend of vertical insight, consultative selling, solution orchestration and commercial ownership. You will work across sales, engineering, service, delivery, finance, partners and product teams to convert customer priorities into scalable, outcome-led propositions.

**Vertical Strategy & Market Development**
------------------------------------------

* Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for the Hospitality and Healthcare verticals, aligned with digitalization, energy efficiency and decarbonization priorities.
* Segment the market by customer type, portfolio size, operating model, asset maturity and sustainability ambition to prioritize high-potential accounts.
* Build vertical-specific value propositions, use cases, account plays and repeatable commercial propositions for India.
* Develop a strong ecosystem with consultants, operators, owners, developers, facility-management companies, ESCOs and technology partners.

**Lead Generation & Pipeline Building**
---------------------------------------

* Independently identify, qualify and develop opportunities across hotel groups, resort portfolios, hospitals, diagnostic networks and healthcare campuses.
* Create demand through strategic outreach, industry networks, executive forums, associations, events, partners, digital channels and referrals.
* Build and maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline across new logos, portfolio expansions, modernization, lifecycle services and recurring digital business.
* Use CRM discipline to maintain opportunity quality, forecasting accuracy, next-step visibility and sales governance.

**Consultative Selling & Executive Engagement**
-----------------------------------------------

* Engage owners, operators, CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CIOs, sustainability leaders, engineering heads, facility leaders and clinical-infrastructure stakeholders.
* Lead discovery to understand business priorities such as guest or patient experience, uptime, energy cost, asset reliability, compliance, standardization and operational visibility.
* Translate operational and sustainability challenges into measurable business cases covering savings, risk reduction, lifecycle value, service outcomes and return on investment.
* Lead customer workshops, concept presentations, solution demonstrations, site discovery and executive-level value discussions.

**Solution & Business Development**
-----------------------------------

* Orchestrate integrated propositions across building and energy management, IoT-enabled asset monitoring, command centers, analytics, digital services, HVAC and chiller optimization, energy monitoring, solar, storage and other relevant sustainability solutions.
* Co-create technically feasible and commercially viable proposals with engineering, service, delivery, finance and partner teams.
* Develop portfolio-level approaches that can begin with pilots and scale across multiple properties, hospitals or campuses.
* Promote lifecycle and recurring-revenue models, including software, analytics, performance services and long-term customer-success engagement.

**Revenue, Commercial & Account Ownership**
-------------------------------------------

* Own order intake, revenue growth, gross-margin quality and target achievement for the assigned verticals.
* Drive opportunity strategy, stakeholder mapping, competition management, proposal quality, negotiation and deal closure.
* Create strategic account plans for priority customers and identify cross-sell, upsell, modernization and replication opportunities.
* Balance customer value, delivery feasibility, contractual risk, pricing discipline and long-term account potential.

**Customer Success & Scale**
----------------------------

* Ensure effective transition from sales to delivery, with clear outcomes, responsibilities, baselines and success measures.
* Partner with delivery and customer-success teams to track adoption, realized value, customer satisfaction and expansion potential.
* Capture references, success stories and reusable proof points that strengthen vertical credibility and accelerate replication.
* Use customer and market feedback to influence solution design, service models, pricing and portfolio roadmap.

**Market Intelligence & Thought Leadership**
--------------------------------------------

* Monitor customer investment priorities, regulations, sustainability commitments, emerging business models, technology trends and competitor activity.
* Represent the organization in hospitality, healthcare, digital-building and sustainability forums.
* Build credible vertical narratives around operational transparency, resilient infrastructure, autonomous operations, energy productivity and measurable outcomes.
* Provide structured market feedback to leadership, product, marketing and strategy teams.

**Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**
-----------------------------------------------

* Act as the vertical champion and mobilize regional sales, key-account, solution, service and partner teams around focused growth plays.
* Establish sales cadence, opportunity reviews, account governance and clear ownership for strategic pursuits.
* Coach teams on vertical use cases, stakeholder priorities, value articulation and consultative selling.
* Collaborate effectively across internal and external stakeholders to deliver an integrated customer experience.

**What You Bring**
==================

* **Experience:** 12+ years in enterprise B2B sales, business development or vertical leadership, preferably in smart infrastructure, building technologies, digital solutions, energy services or sustainability.
* **Vertical Knowledge:** Strong understanding of hospitality and/or healthcare operating environments, stakeholder priorities, asset-intensive operations and investment decision processes.
* **Sales Leadership:** Demonstrated success in lead generation, consultative selling, strategic account development, complex solution sales and senior stakeholder engagement.
* **Digital & Sustainability Acumen:** Ability to connect digital infrastructure, operational technology, energy performance and decarbonization outcomes to customer business priorities.
* **Commercial Capability:** Strong command of business-case development, ROI and lifecycle-value articulation, pricing, negotiation, contracts and deal governance.
* **Solution Orientation:** Ability to integrate multiple technologies and services into a coherent, outcome-led proposition rather than sell standalone products.
* **Tools Proficiency:** Working proficiency in CRM platforms and Microsoft 365; comfort using data and dashboards for pipeline and business management.
* **Communication:** Executive presence with strong presentation, facilitation, negotiation and written communication skills.
* **Mindset:** Entrepreneurial, externally oriented, collaborative and accountable, with the ability to build a market while driving near-term results.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Engineering or technology degree; a postgraduate qualification in business, energy, sustainability or a related field is an advantage.
* Experience with hotel chains, hospital groups, real-estate owners, operators, consultants or facility-management ecosystems.
* Exposure to digital building platforms, building automation, HVAC optimization, energy analytics, renewable energy, storage or performance-based solutions.
* Experience building multi-site or portfolio-level programs and scaling pilots into repeatable business.

**Success Measures**
====================

* Qualified pipeline creation and conversion across Hospitality and Healthcare.
* Order intake, revenue, margin quality and recurring digital or service business growth.
* New customer acquisition and penetration of priority strategic accounts.
* Pilot-to-scale conversion and replication across multi-site customer portfolios.
* Customer adoption, realized value, reference creation and long-term account expansion.

title: Head of Sales & Business Development
description:
**Job Description:** Head of Sales

We work with enterprises on technology and digital transformation initiatives. Our offerings span technology services and solutions, alongside a software platform focused on resource allocation and capacity planning, helping professional services teams make better-informed decisions around resource utilization and delivery planning.

We are looking for a commercially driven sales professional who can open doors, build trusted CXO relationships, and convert opportunities into meaningful revenue. This is a hands-on business development role for someone who can sell complex technology services as well as SaaS products, develop enterprise opportunities, and help build a repeatable sales pipeline.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**

* **New Business Development:** Identify, prospect, and convert new enterprise opportunities across IT services, digital transformation, cloud, AI, and enterprise software.
* **Enterprise Deal Ownership:** Own the sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through solution discussions, proposals, negotiation, and closure.
* **CXO & Account Relationships:** Build trusted relationships with C-level executives and senior decision-makers, turning account access into qualified opportunities and long-term partnerships.
* **International Market Development:** Develop opportunities across priority markets such as the Middle East, UK, and US; exposure to India-based enterprise accounts is also valuable.
* **Services & Product Sales:** Position technology services alongside resource planning and capacity management software capabilities.
* **Pipeline & Revenue Accountability:** Maintain a healthy pipeline, qualify opportunities, prepare forecasts, and track progress against revenue and conversion goals.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work with technical, delivery, product, and leadership teams to shape solutions, strengthen proposals, and ensure a smooth transition from sale to delivery.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Experience:** 7–10 years in B2B sales or business development, preferably within IT services, digital transformation, SaaS, cloud, AI, or enterprise software.
* **A Proven Hunter:** Demonstrated ability to generate new business personally—not just manage inherited accounts or oversee a sales team.
* **High-value Deal Closures:** Experience personally owning and closing significant enterprise deals; exposure to deal sizes in the ₹50 lakh–₹5 crore+ range is strongly preferred.
* **CXO Relationships:** Established relationships with senior business and technology decision-makers and the confidence to engage them in consultative sales conversations.
* **International Sales Exposure:** Experience selling into the Middle East, UK, or US is preferred.
* **Services & Product Selling:** Comfortable selling both technology services and software products, with the ability to understand client needs and articulate business value.
* **Commercial Skills:** Strong prospecting, discovery, negotiation, proposal development, pipeline management, and forecasting capabilities.
* **Ownership & Team Building:** Self-driven and accountable, with the ability to contribute to a growing sales function and take on team-building responsibilities as the business scales.
* **Professional Integrity:** A record of maintaining positive professional relationships with previous employers and clients; references may be checked.

**WHAT WILL HELP YOU STAND OUT**

* Ability to discuss specific named accounts, deal values, sales-cycle ownership, and measurable business outcomes.
* A relevant enterprise network and the ability to develop warm introductions during the hiring process or early in the role, where appropriate.
* A builder’s mindset: motivated to create market access, establish a repeatable sales motion, and grow with the business.

**WHY JOIN US**

* **Services & SaaS Exposure:** Work across enterprise technology services and a focused SaaS product.
* **Business-critical Solutions:** Help clients address technology and operational challenges through practical, technology-led solutions.
* **Ownership & Growth:** Build customer relationships, develop pipeline, and contribute directly to business growth.
* **Global Opportunities:** Engage with enterprise stakeholders and pursue opportunities across international markets.

If interested, please apply on the Job Posting at the earliest.

Pay: ₹1,800,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: R&D Executive
description:
**Job description**

**Company:** Fibre Foils Ltd.

**Department:** Research & Development  
**Location:** Khopoli Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 2-6 Years in Polymer / PVA/ PVAc Adhesives R&D  
**Qualification:** M.Sc. Chemistry / Polymer or engineering in Polymer / Chemical

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an R&D Executive with hands-on experience in PVA / PVAC ADHESIVE to develop and optimize formulations for adhesives, coatings, and related applications. The role involves lab-scale development, testing, troubleshooting, and supporting commercialization**.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Formulation & Synthesis:** Design and execute laboratory experiments to develop novel or improved PVA/PVAc emulsions, tackifiers, and protective colloids.
* **Performance Testing:** Evaluate viscosity, pH, solid content, shear strength, peel/tensile adhesion, freeze-thaw stability, and aging characteristics.
* **Process Optimization:** Study emulsion polymerization kinetics, stabilizer selection, and additive integration (plasticizers, defoamers, crosslinkers).
* **Scale-Up & Production Support:** Translate lab-scale formulas into pilot and full-scale manufacturing batches; troubleshoot plant-level viscosity or stability issues.
* **Customer & Field Trials:** Collaborate with technical service and commercial teams to run trials at customer manufacturing lines (e.g., paper packaging, woodworking, or labeling).
* **Documentation & Compliance:** Maintain detailed lab notebooks, generate standard operating procedures (SOPs), and ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety (EHS) and REACH/VOC standards.

· **Cross-Functional Coordination**

Work closely with Production, QC, and Technical Services teams

**Experience**

· **Industry Experience:** 2+ years of hands-on industrial R&D or formulation experience in water-based adhesives, emulsions (VAE/PVAc), or coatings.

· **Technical Knowledge:** Deep understanding of polymer chemistry, emulsion polymerization mechanisms, rheology, and PVA hydrolysis grades.

**Core Competencies**

· **Analytical Skills:** Proficiency in testing equipment (viscometers, GPC, FTIR, TGA/DSC, universal testing machines).

· **Problem-Solving:** Ability to troubleshoot shelf-life, coalescence, or bonding failures under varying environmental conditions.

· **Communication:** Clear technical reporting and cross-functional teamwork with production, quality control (QC), and sales.

Pay: From ₹414,000.00 per year

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: RIS Oracle Tech/AI SA Manager
description:
Job Description Overview
  
As an Oracle Solution Architect, you will help organizations transform enterprises through Oracle solutions spanning HCM, finance, EPM, procurement, projects, supply chain, manufacturing, CX, sales, service, marketing, commerce, analytics, data, integration, cloud infrastructure, AI, and industry capabilities. You will define business strategies, design Oracle-enabled transformations, and architect scalable solutions that deliver measurable business value. **We Are:**  
Accenture helps organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate growth, and enhance services through technology, data, and AI.

Our Oracle Solution Architect Team partners with clients, account teams, and delivery organizations to shape Oracle transformation programs, leading solution strategy, architecture, estimation, and pursuits.

A client-focused Oracle Solution Architect who combines Oracle product knowledge with consulting, communication, and leadership skills. You translate requirements into Oracle solutions and lead architecture discussions, design sessions, and strategic pursuits.

Build Oracle solutions that transform clients' business operations
  
Design and test Oracle solutions, ensuring processes, integrations, data, reporting, and security work together
  
Work with project teams and clients to create solutions and transformation roadmaps
  
Lead discovery sessions, architecture discussions, solution design workshops, and executive presentations
  
Develop trusted client relationships
  
Support sales pursuits, including solution development, estimation, proposals, demonstrations, and solution reviews
  
Build Oracle technical, functional, industry, and business expertise
  
Travel may be required based on business need and client requirements.

Minimum of 5 years of Oracle Cloud implementation and delivery experience
  
Experience supporting or leading full lifecycle Oracle Cloud implementations, including design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization
  
Experience leading solution architecture, business process design, and client workshops
  
Expertise in one or more Oracle areas, including HCM, ERP, EPM, Procurement, Project Management, SCM, Manufacturing, CX, Sales, Service, Marketing, Commerce, Analytics, Data Management, Integration, OCI, AI, or industry solutions
  
Experience translating business requirements into scalable Oracle solution designs
  
Fluency in AI Oracle Agentic AI & industry trends
  
Understanding of integration, reporting, security, data conversion, and testing
  
Experience supporting proposals, estimation, solution reviews, and sales pursuits
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  
Professional Skills Requirements
  
Oracle Cloud certifications relevant to your area
  
Experience working directly with clients
  
Ability to present solution recommendations and transformation strategies to executive stakeholders
  
Ability to facilitate client workshops, discovery sessions, and design discussions
  
Strong consulting, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
  
Experience collaborating across sales, consulting, delivery, industry, and technology teams
  
Ability to work effectively with global teams
  
  
**Bonus Points If:**  
You hold multiple Oracle Cloud certifications
  
You have expertise across multiple Oracle pillars, including SaaS, PaaS, OCI, data, integration, analytics, AI, or industry solutions

description:

* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
* Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, or penetration testing).

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.

"The Manager - Customer Data Stewardship is responsible for leading Eaton's global Customer Data Stewardship organization within the Data Enablement Center of Excellence (CoE) at Sales & Marketing Center (SMC). Operating within a federated data management model, this role partners closely with Business Data Owners, Enterprise Data Governance, MDM platform teams, Process Excellence, IT, and business stakeholders to drive customer data quality, business adoption, operational excellence, and stewardship maturity. The role is accountable for transforming customer data into a trusted enterprise asset by establishing robust stewardship practices, enabling scalable operating models, fostering continuous improvement, and evolving the organization toward AI-augmented stewardship and intelligent automation capabilities"

Lead stewardship support for customer master data across both MDM and source systems, ensuring timely resolution of data issues and root-cause elimination.  
Develop and maintain stewardship performance dashboards, service metrics, and governance reporting to measure operational effectiveness and business impact.  
Identify and implement opportunities for process simplification, intelligent automation, and productivity improvements across stewardship operations.  
Foster the adoption of AI-assisted stewardship capabilities, enabling more efficient data validation, standardization, enrichment, and exception management while maintaining appropriate business oversight.  
Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders on customer data management, data quality improvement, and stewardship best practices."

title: Service planner
description:
**Service Planner / Senior Service Planner | Rentokil PCI**
-----------------------------------------------------------

Responsible for end-to-end service planning, scheduling, and coordination of pest control operations to ensure timely service delivery, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and achievement of branch performance targets.

### **Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Service Planning & Scheduling:** Plan, organize, and manage daily, weekly, and monthly service schedules for technicians, covering routine contractual services, renewals, jobbing, call-outs, customer enquiries, and complaint visits. Ensure optimal resource allocation and on-time service execution while minimizing pending visits and service backlogs.
* **Technician Allocation & Productivity:** Allocate service jobs based on technician availability, territory knowledge, travel time, time spent at customer sites, routine service requirements, and business priorities. Monitor technician-wise productivity and efficiency KPIs, coordinate annual leave planning, and ensure service productivity targets are achieved. Assign jobbing work to route technicians only after completing their scheduled routine services.
* **Service Performance & Compliance:** Monitor daily service compliance, State of Service (SOS), branch performance, and technician-wise service trends. Review service reports with the Operations Manager (OM), Operations Executive (OE), and Branch Manager (BM), identify critical backlogs and performance gaps, and escalate unresolved issues for timely resolution.
* **Customer Service & Complaint Management:** Prioritize and coordinate renewal visits, customer enquiries, urgent call-outs, complaints, and service requests. Liaise with Sales and Operations teams to accommodate urgent appointments and scheduling changes, ensuring customers are informed promptly. Handle customer service complaints, termination notifications, and STOP Service requests effectively. Ensure call-out tickets are raised before complaints are assigned for service.
* **Digital Systems & Service Companion Management:** Develop and maintain proficiency in company systems, including iCABS, SCP, Service Companion, and other operational platforms. Ensure 100% activation and availability of Service Companion devices and maintain usage above 95%. Coordinate with the IT team regarding new user access, device issues, and system-related concerns.
* **Data Management & Documentation:** Maintain accurate and timely service records across dockets, log cards, service orders, visit documents, and other operational sources. Ensure correct consumption data and TOS entries in SCP to support accurate customer-wise account profitability reporting. Follow up on customer and technician feedback and maintain documentation integrity while supporting the transition from paper-based processes to digital service planning.
* **Reporting & Analysis:** Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly State of Service (SOS) reports, including priority reporting for Residential GSS SOS. Submit weekly pending-job and ageing-profile reports to the Assistant Branch Manager (ABM) or Branch Manager. Maintain monthly technician-wise performance trends, productivity data, complaint visibility, call-out records, and critical incident reports.
* **Sales & Operations Coordination:** Maintain effective communication and working relationships with Sales, Operations, service supervisors, technicians, branch management, customers, and internal support teams. Coordinate available service slots and scheduling adjustments for new sales, align service requirements, and ensure timely communication of operational issues to the appropriate management team.
* **Territory & Route Optimization:** Work with branch management to review and optimize service territories based on annual area revenue, travel time, time on site, and routine service requirements. Ensure balanced workload distribution and efficient use of technician resources.
* **Safety & Escalation Management:** Understand and follow company safety policies and Safety Risk Assessment (SRA) requirements. Ensure service-related issues, critical incidents, and unresolved operational concerns are escalated promptly to the appropriate management level.

### **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achieve on-time service planning with zero pending services at the end of each month.
* Maintain 100% active Service Companion devices and usage above 95%.
* Minimize service backlogs and meet contractual service obligations.
* Achieve continuous improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet assigned branch targets.
* Monitor technician-wise productivity, efficiency, and service compliance.
* Maintain accurate service data, documentation, and timely operational reporting.
* Ensure effective complaint handling and timely resolution of service issues.

### **Core Skills**

* Service planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
* Operations coordination and workflow management
* Technician productivity and KPI monitoring
* Customer relationship and complaint management
* Data accuracy, documentation, and reporting
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Territory and route optimization
* Communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management
* Digital systems proficiency and attention to detail
* Decision-making, organization, and adaptability in a dynamic service environment

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications & Working Relationships**

Graduate with 1–3 years of relevant team-management experience, basic computer proficiency, good communication skills, and knowledge of the assigned service territory. The role requires coordination with customers, Sales, Operations, technicians, supervisors, and business support functions, with occasional travel within the division as required.

 **Benefits**  

### **Company Profile & Employee Benefits**

**Association with a UK-Based Multinational Corporation**

* Opportunity to work with Rentokil PCI, part of the Rentokil Initial group, a UK-headquartered global business services company and a recognized leader in pest control and hygiene services.
* Exposure to international service standards, structured business processes, digital technologies, and global best practices.
* Opportunity to develop professional skills in a large, established organization with operations across multiple countries.
* Experience working in a professional corporate environment that emphasizes safety, integrity, innovation, learning and development, inclusion, and performance excellence.

### **Employment & Social Security Benefits**

Subject to employment terms, eligibility, and applicable company policies, potential benefits may include:

* **Provident Fund (PF):** Retirement savings through eligible contributions by the employee and employer.
* **Employees' State Insurance (ESIC):** Medical care and other eligible sickness, maternity, disability, and related benefits under the ESI scheme.
* **Gratuity:** A statutory terminal benefit, subject to applicable eligibility conditions.
* **Paid Leave:** Eligible annual, casual, sick, and other leave as per company policy and applicable law.
* **Job Stability:** The opportunity to build experience and a career within an established multinational business.
* **Learning & Development:** Potential access to role-related training, digital systems, operational processes, and professional development initiatives.
* **Career Advancement:** Opportunities to develop expertise in service planning, operations coordination, productivity management, reporting, and leadership, subject to performance and available vacancies.
* **Corporate Work Experience:** Exposure to structured reporting, performance measurement, customer service standards, safety practices, and cross-functional teamwork.

### **Professional Growth & Future Opportunities**

Working as a Service Planner / Senior Service Planner can strengthen expertise in service scheduling, resource allocation, technician productivity, customer relationship management, KPI analysis, digital operations, and service quality improvement. These transferable skills can support future applications for senior planning, operations coordination, service delivery, and operations management positions.

* **Deadline Tracking:** Rigorously monitor submission timelines to ensure 100% on-time delivery, including physical checking, binding, packing, and dispatch for offline tenders.

2. Sales Coordination & Administration

* **Sales Documentation:** Prepare accurate quotations, Proforma Invoices (PI), and customer-facing commercial documentation.

Key Qualifications & Requirements

* **Experience:** Minimum **3-5 years** of proven experience in end-to-end tendering and sales coordination.
* **Technical Expertise:** Hands-on experience with:

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. Drive sustainable profitable growth for the International Solutions Business, powering profitable order acquisition, strategic account development, market expansion, and customer relationships across targeted international markets. title: Accounts and Administration Assistant
description:
**Job Description** – Accounts & Administration Assistant

**Industry:** Chartered Accountancy Firm  
**Department:** Accounts & Administration  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com/ MBA or equivalent  
**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a responsible, experienced, and well-organized Accounts & Administration Executive to manage the firm's internal accounting, financial records, office administration, and day-to-day operational activities. The candidate should be capable of independently handling routine accounting functions, coordinating with clients and vendors, maintaining proper documentation, and ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the office.

**Key Responsibilities** 1. Accounts & Finance

* Handle day-to-day accounting entries, including receipts, payments, expenses, sales, and purchases.
* Maintain books of accounts, general ledgers, cash book, bank book, and petty cash records.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable, vendor payments, and outstanding follow-ups.
* Perform bank reconciliation and ledger reconciliation on a regular basis.
* Prepare and maintain payment vouchers, expense statements, invoices, and supporting documents.
* Monitor office expenses, payment schedules, and cash requirements.
* Maintain accurate accounting records using Tally Prime and MS Excel.
* Coordinate with banks, vendors, and external consultants regarding accounting and financial matters.
* Assist in preparing monthly financial statements, management reports, and audit-related records.
* Ensure timely recording of transactions and proper maintenance of financial documents.

2. **Office Administration**

* Manage the day-to-day administrative operations of the CA firm.
* Maintain office records, files, stationery, assets, and administrative documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for office maintenance, purchases, and other requirements.
* Monitor office expenses, utility bills, subscriptions, and service contracts.
* Ensure timely payment of rent, electricity, internet, telephone, and other office-related bills.
* Handle office correspondence, emails, courier services, and documentation.
* Maintain proper filing systems for important documents and records.
* Ensure the availability of office supplies and smooth functioning of office facilities.
* Maintain confidentiality of financial, client, and other sensitive information.

3. **Staff & Operational Coordination**

* Coordinate with staff members to ensure smooth day-to-day office operations.
* Follow up on pending assignments, client documentation, and important deadlines.
* Coordinate with the CA and senior team members to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Monitor work progress and follow up with team members on pending activities.
* Coordinate internal meetings, schedules, and other office-related activities.
* Maintain effective communication and coordination among team members.
* Identify operational gaps and suggest improvements in office processes and workflow.

4. **Documentation & Compliance Support**

* Maintain organized records of invoices, bills, receipts, agreements, and other important documents.
* Track pending documents and follow up with clients, vendors, and relevant team members.
* Assist in collecting and organizing documents required for accounting, audit, and compliance assignments.
* Maintain records of important dates, renewals, payments, and other office-related deadlines.
* Ensure that documents are properly filed, updated, and readily accessible when required.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* B.Com / M.Com/ MBA or an equivalent qualification.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in accounts and administration, preferably in a CA firm or professional services organization.
* Good working knowledge of Tally Prime, MS Excel, and MS Office.
* Practical knowledge of bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, expense management, and vendor coordination.
* Basic understanding of GST and TDS documentation and accounting requirements.
* Strong organizational, communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities with minimal supervision.
* Attention to detail, professional integrity, and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

**Key Expectations**

* Independently manage routine accounting and administrative activities.
* Ensure accuracy and timely maintenance of books of accounts and financial records.
* Maintain effective coordination with management, staff, clients, and vendors.
* Ensure smooth day-to-day office operations and timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Proactively monitor pending payments, documents, and important deadlines.
* Maintain a systematic and professional working environment.

**Salary:** As per experience and suitability.

**Work Location:** Andheri West ( Metro Station )

Pay: From ₹30,000.00 per month

**Job Description: Pre-Sales Executive / SDR – Demo Booking**

**Company:** Tagway  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Department:** Marketing & Sales

**About Tagway**

Tagway provides RFID inventory automation solutions for jewelry businesses, helping them complete stock checks faster, improve inventory visibility and reduce manual work.

**Role Objective**

Convert incoming enquiries and assigned prospects into **qualified, attended product demos** through calling, WhatsApp follow-up and effective appointment management.

You will work alongside our existing pre-sales executive and sales team to support a team target of **16 completed demos per working day**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Call fresh leads promptly, prioritizing interested prospects and businesses that match our customer profile.
* Handle a high daily calling volume across fresh leads, unanswered calls, follow-ups and older enquiries.
* Understand the prospect’s business, inventory challenges, number of stores, inventory size, ERP and purchase timeline.
* Explain Tagway’s value clearly and secure a demo with the business owner, decision-maker or relevant stakeholder.
* Handle objections such as “busy with customers,” “send the price first,” “call later” and “my partner needs to attend.”
* Agree on a suitable demo time and coordinate with the assigned sales representative.
* Send confirmations, demo details and reminders through approved channels.
* Reconfirm attendance, follow up on missed demos and arrange rescheduling.
* Keep Zoho CRM updated with call outcomes, qualification details, demo appointments and next actions.
* Report daily calling activity, qualified bookings, attended demos and reasons for cancellations or no-shows.

**Performance Expectations**

The following are initial targets, to be validated during onboarding against lead quality, connection rates and calling tools:

**Metric**

**Initial expectation**

Daily outbound call attempts

80-100 fresh leads and follow ups

Qualified demos booked

10-16 qualified Demos

Completed demos from own bookings

9-12 completed Demos

Demo attendance rate

80%

Fresh-lead response

Follow the company’s working-hours SLA

CRM updates

Every call outcome and next action recorded the same day

Performance will be assessed on **qualified demos attended**, supported by calling productivity, follow-up discipline and CRM accuracy.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Proven experience in outbound tele sales, BPO sales, inside sales, pre-sales or appointment setting.
* Demonstrated success converting calls into appointments or sales opportunities.
* Strong spoken Hindi and English; additional Indian languages are an advantage.
* Confidence speaking with business owners and handling objections.
* Ability to sustain calling activity while listening carefully and qualifying prospects.
* Experience using CRM software and managing scheduled follow-ups.
* Strong ownership of appointments from first contact through demo attendance.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in B2B appointment setting, software sales, ERP, retail technology or jewelry-related solutions is preferred.

Candidates from BPO environments are welcome, particularly those with **outbound sales and conversion targets**. Customer-support experience alone is insufficient without evidence of selling or appointment setting.

**Selection Process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete:

* A discussion of previous calling volumes, appointment targets and actual results.
* A mock call with a jewelry business owner.
* Objection-handling exercises.
* A short CRM and follow-up planning exercise.

**Compensation**

Fixed salary plus performance incentives linked to **qualified, attended demos**, with targets and qualification criteria agreed upfront.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹34,000.00 per month
