title: Sr Director Sales Excellence
description:
**Senior Director Sales Excellence**

**Key Responsibilities**

The Senior Director, Sales Excellence, will **partner closely with Process Technologies (PT) Commercial and Catalyst Technologies (CT) Sales Leadership to drive commercial performance, sales effectiveness and profitable growth** . The role will lead the design and execution of the commercial operating system, leveraging data, AI, digital capabilities and cross-functional collaboration to improve sales productivity, customer growth and revenue synergies. The role will also lead strategic commercial initiatives and build the capabilities, processes and tools required to enable a high-performing sales organization.

  

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* **Bachelor’s degree** with **10+ years of experience** in customer-facing roles, including sales, business development, marketing, sales operations or sales excellence, with demonstrated leadership experience.
* **3+ years of experience in Sales Excellence, Sales Operations or Commercial Excellence** , with a strong track record of improving sales effectiveness, processes, tools and performance.
* **5+ years of experience in process technologies, industrial automation, systems or related B2B industrial businesses** , including experience in direct sales and/or channel management.
* Proven experience leading **functional and cross-functional teams in complex, matrix organizations** , with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across multiple business lines and functions without direct authority.
* Demonstrated track record of **developing and executing commercial strategies, growth initiatives and business transformation programs** , with the ability to translate strategy into measurable business outcomes.
* Excellent **communication, presentation, influencing and interpersonal skills** , with the ability to engage and influence senior and executive leadership, combined with strong strategic thinking, forward planning and a continuous-improvement mindset.

**WE VALUE**

* Global mindset and cultural awareness, with the ability to work effectively across geographies, cultures and diverse teams in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.
* Strong Commercial/Sales Excellence and transformation experience, with a focus on sales operations, process improvement, change management and continuous improvement.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior and executive stakeholders, build alignment and drive results without direct authority.
* Inclusive and empowering leadership, with the ability to motivate, develop and inspire teams while effectively managing complex organizational environments.
* Strong understanding of business drivers and value creation, ideally supported by an MBA and/or experience with methodologies such as Six Sigma, process mapping, value-stream mapping and Lean.

  

A summary is mentioned in the following table:

**Responsibility Area**

**Core Focus**

  

1. Sales Operations and Process Excellence

Drive the Sales MOS, pipeline sufficiency, lead-to-revenue management, forecasting, sales reporting, sales behaviors and continuous improvement of sales processes and tools.

  

2. SFDC (CRM) Development and Deployment for CT

Lead CRM development and deployment for CT, including transition to Honeywell/PT sales processes, change management, training and adoption.

  

3. AI Driven Sales Excellence and Enablement

Define and execute the AI/digital sales roadmap and deploy AI-enabled tools, analytics and solutions to improve sales effectiveness, productivity and decision-making.

  

4. Strategic Account Management

Partner with the strategic accounts leader and drive cross-business revenue synergies across CT, PT and PA through integrated account strategies and growth initiatives.

  

5. Sales Effectiveness, Capability & Incentives

Strengthen sales capabilities, competencies and behaviors, while driving sales effectiveness, incentive programs and consistent sales standards.

  

6. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead the Commercial Excellence team, partner with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders, and drive adoption of commercial excellence priorities and ways of working.

  

7. Execution of Strategic Projects

Lead high-impact commercial transformation initiatives, including pricing excellence, commercial productivity and cross-business growth and revenue synergy programs.

**1. Sales Operations and Process Excellence**

* Drive **pipeline sufficiency and order pipeline development** , ensuring appropriate pipeline coverage, quality, progression and conversion to support business growth objectives.
* Own and continuously improve the **Sales Management Operating System (MOS)** for the Catalyst Technologies under Process Technologies business, establishing clear performance rhythms, metrics, governance and accountability to drive sales effectiveness.
* Drive disciplined **lead management and lead-to-revenue processes** , improving lead qualification, conversion, sales velocity and win rates.
* Monitor and provide insights on key **sales behaviors and activity metrics** , identifying opportunities to improve seller effectiveness, customer engagement and sales productivity.
* Provide reliable and timely **sales, order, pipeline, forecast, customer and commercial performance reporting** , including scorecards and dashboards for Sales and Business Leadership.
* Lead continuous improvement, simplification, standardization and automation of **sales processes, tools and operating practices** , improving data quality, seller productivity and ease of use.
* Champion adoption and compliance with the global sales model, Sales MOS, commercial processes, standards and best practices across the Process Technologies organization.

**2. SFDC (CRM) Development and Deployment for CT**

* Lead the **development, deployment and continuous enhancement of SFDC (CRM) capabilities for CT** , ensuring alignment with Honeywell/PT sales processes, business requirements and commercial priorities.
* Drive CT’s **transition and adoption of Honeywell/PT sales processes and CRM ways of working** , including change management, stakeholder engagement, communications, training and ongoing adoption tracking.
* Partner with PT Sales Enablement and relevant functional teams to **deploy sales training, tools and best practices across the CT sales organization** , ensuring consistent adoption of the new sales model and sustained CRM utilization.

**3. AI Driven Sales Excellence and Enablement**

* Define and execute the AI and digital roadmap for Sales, identifying and prioritizing strategic AI initiatives that enhance sales effectiveness, productivity and customer engagement across the sales force.
* Drive actionable data, analytics and AI-enabled insights to improve sales performance, identify growth opportunities, strengthen pipeline and forecast visibility, and enable data-driven commercial decision-making.
* Lead the development and adoption of AI-enabled dashboards, tools and sales solutions that improve pipeline management, customer intelligence, sales productivity and the ability to win new customers and expand existing customer relationships.
* Drive end-to-end implementation and adoption of AI solutions across the sales organization, partnering with Sales, IT, Digital, Data & Analytics and other stakeholders, and tracking business impact and value realization.
* Partner with the strategic accounts leader to support the portfolio of **high-priority strategic accounts** with significant revenue, growth and strategic importance to Process Technologies.
* Collaborate with the sales teams to identify **cross-business revenue synergies across CT, PT and PA** , developing integrated account plans and coordinated sales strategies to increase share of wallet and expand the Honeywell relationship.
* Partner with Sales, Product Management and business leaders to develop and execute **joint account growth plans** , identify whitespace opportunities, and drive conversion of strategic opportunities across multiple Honeywell businesses.

4. **Strategic Account Management**

**5. Sales Effectiveness, Capability & Incentives**

title: Outward & Dispatch Executive
description:
We are a leading aerospace and defence trading company, specializing in the supply of consumables, spare parts, and equipment. We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Operations & Dispatch Executive to support our logistics, inventory, and dispatch operations. The role involves coordinating material movement, maintaining records, ensuring timely deliveries, and supporting smooth day-to-day supply chain activities.

Job Description:

**A. Dispatch Order Processing**

* Receive and review Delivery Orders (DOs), Purchase Orders (POs), and dispatch requisitions from authorised personnel.
* Verify product details, part numbers, quantities, specifications, pack sizes, colour codes, shelf life, delivery address, and required delivery dates.
* Prepare the required copies of the Delivery Order and share them with the Stores Team for material picking.
* Generate Material Requests (MRs) in the RSR software.
* Coordinate with Stores for material picking, packing, and preparation of the Store Out Note (SON).
* Proceed with dispatch documentation after confirmation of material handover and completion of the store-out process.
* Prepare applicable Joint Venture (JV) entries for raw material combinations and quantity conversions as per the work instruction.

**B. Dispatch Documentation**

* Prepare Delivery Challans, invoices, Release Notes/Certificates of Conformance (CoC), and dispatch checklists.
* Arrange supporting documents such as MSDS, TDS, test reports, Manufacturer's Certificate of Conformance, and Boeing Batch Approval Certificate, wherever required.
* Verify dispatch documents against the customer requirements and prescribed checklist.
* Prepare two sets of dispatch documents: one for the customer and one for company records.
* Arrange additional invoice copies as required by customers or courier agencies.
* Coordinate SEZ/EOU shipment documentation, including LUT Bond and DTA copies, wherever applicable.
* Submit the relevant shipment documents to Accounts for record-keeping.
* Maintain dispatch documentation and records as per company procedures.

**C. Material Verification and Packaging**

* Coordinate with Stores to ensure the correct products and quantities are picked against the Delivery Order.
* Verify part numbers, specifications, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, expiry dates, and shelf life, wherever applicable.
* Ensure materials are properly sealed and protected against leakage or transit damage.
* Coordinate suitable packaging using cartons, bubble wrap, cushioning materials, pallets, and stretch film, as required.
* Ensure packages are labelled with product details, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, colour codes, safety instructions, and handling requirements, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate product inspection and shipment photographs for trans-shipment consignments.
* Ensure hazardous materials are packaged, labelled, and handled according to applicable requirements.

**D. Temperature-Sensitive Material Dispatch**

* Identify temperature-sensitive materials requiring special shipping arrangements.
* Arrange insulated packaging, cooling materials, and data loggers as required.
* Ensure two data loggers are placed in the shipment, including one backup logger, as prescribed in the work instruction.
* Activate and position the data loggers correctly before shipment.
* Record the data logger serial numbers and provide handling or reading instructions when required.
* Obtain the prescribed *Life Span of Temperature Sensitive Material* form (FORM/SCDIS/RSR/63) from Stores.
* Photograph the material before packing and complete the prescribed form.
* Ensure temperature-sensitive material dispatch is processed within the bonded store as specified in the work instruction.

**E. Shipment Coordination and Tracking**

* Coordinate with courier agencies, transporters, freight forwarders, and the Logistics Team for timely dispatch.
* Assist in selecting suitable transportation based on shipment size, destination, material type, and delivery timeline.
* Coordinate safe loading and transportation of materials.
* Ensure dispatches are planned according to the required delivery dates.
* Share dispatch documents and shipment tracking details with customers through email.
* Communicate dispatched and pending product details to the relevant stakeholders.
* Track shipments until final delivery.
* Follow up with logistics partners regarding shipment delays and delivery issues.
* Inform the Sales Team and customers promptly about delays or changes affecting delivery timelines.

**F. Proof of Delivery and Record Maintenance**

* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD) from courier agencies or delivery personnel.
* Share POD copies with customers and obtain receipt acknowledgement wherever required.
* Maintain dispatch records, tracking details, delivery confirmations, and PODs.
* Update dispatch information accurately in the RSR software and relevant tracking sheets.
* Ensure records are complete, traceable, and readily available for audits.

**G. Coordination and Compliance**

* Coordinate with Sales, Stores, Quality, Accounts, and Logistics to ensure smooth dispatch operations.
* Escalate discrepancies in material details, documentation, packaging, or shipment status before dispatch.
* Coordinate with the Quality Team for customer complaints involving damaged, incorrect, or missing materials.

This role requires someone who can anticipate requirements, handle confidential information, communicate professionally and bring structure to a fast-moving business environment.

The ideal candidate is not someone who simply takes instructions, but someone who takes ownership, follows through and ensures that nothing important slips through the cracks.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Calendar and Time Management**

* Manage the CEO’s daily calendar, appointments, meetings and commitments.
* Schedule internal and external meetings, ensuring adequate preparation and time allocation.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, hotel bookings, itineraries and meeting schedules for domestic and international travel.
* Prioritise requests and help the CEO focus on the most important business activities.
* Maintain a daily agenda and share a concise schedule and priority list with the CEO.

**2. Coordination with Department Heads**

* Coordinate with project management, design, production, accounts, sales, operations and administration teams.
* Follow up with department heads on pending tasks, commitments and deadlines assigned by the CEO.
* Maintain a central tracker of important action items and escalate delays or unresolved issues.
* Ensure that instructions given during meetings are communicated clearly and acted upon.
* Help the CEO monitor progress on key business priorities without getting involved in routine execution.

**3. Meeting Management and Follow-ups**

* Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes and relevant documents.
* Record meeting minutes, decisions, responsibilities and deadlines.
* Circulate action points to the concerned team members and follow up until closure.
* Prepare a daily or weekly summary of pending decisions and overdue tasks.
* Organise documents and information required for client meetings, internal reviews and business discussions.

**4. Business and Administrative Support**

* Draft and review professional emails, letters, WhatsApp messages and internal communications.
* Prepare presentations, reports, spreadsheets and summaries as required.
* Coordinate with clients, vendors, consultants and other business stakeholders on behalf of the CEO.
* Assist with documentation, approvals, quotations, payment follow-ups and other matters requiring the CEO’s attention.
* Maintain an organised digital filing system for important business documents.
* Support special projects, business initiatives and assignments delegated by the CEO.

**5. CEO’s Office and Priority Management**

* Maintain a master task tracker covering the CEO’s key priorities and outstanding commitments.
* Identify pending approvals, delayed responses and tasks requiring intervention.
* Prepare a daily briefing highlighting the CEO’s priorities, urgent matters and important updates.
* Ensure that important communications are brought to the CEO’s attention promptly.
* Anticipate requirements and resolve routine coordination issues independently wherever authorised.

**6. Confidentiality and Professional Conduct**

* Handle sensitive business, financial, employee and client information with discretion.
* Maintain professionalism when interacting with senior management, clients and external stakeholders.
* Exercise sound judgement when prioritising communications and sharing information.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure that confidential documents are handled appropriately.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management or a related field preferred.

description:
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for a commercially sharp, empathetic sales professional who can engage with **qualified, warm leads**, including entrepreneurs who have completed a free business audit, and convert genuine business needs into appropriate paid engagements.

This role focuses on **consultative sales calls and closing high-value assignments worth lakhs**, rather than mass cold calling or selling a generic subscription.

Our work spans business growth, strategy, coaching and AI-enabled solutions for entrepreneurs and service businesses. The customer journey begins with a **free business audit** and a relevant conversation. **Senior Executive – International Sales**

**Company:** ALAN Electronic Systems Private Limited

**Department:** International Sales

**Location:** Head Office, Ambernath, Maharashtra (international travel required)

**Reporting To:** Head of Department – International Sales

**Experience:** 8 - 12 years

**Role Overview:**

The Senior Executive – International Sales owns the execution quality of ALAN's international sales administration: order processing, export documentation, dispatch, payment collection and partner support. The role leads the Executive and Junior Executive who perform these tasks and is accountable for every activity being completed within the defined timelines. The role also resolves technical issues raised by sales partners on ALAN products, prepares AOP data and presentations, plans and executes the Annual Sales & Service Partners Meeting (ASPM), and represents ALAN at international exhibitions and conferences.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Order Processing Oversight**

* Ensure partner POs are received, verified against the approved price list, discounts, payment terms, and booked in ERP within the defined TAT
* Review and approve proforma invoices and order confirmations before release to the partner
* Ensure country-specific requirements are checked before booking: product registration, CE certificate validity, import permits and labelling
* Review partner credit status and outstanding dues on each order; take exceptions to the HoD for approval
* Review the order register daily for pending, delayed and incorrectly booked orders

**2. Fulfilment and Dispatch Monitoring**

* Monitor order status against committed dates; coordinate with planning, production, stores and QC to remove delays
* Ensure partners receive revised dates before the due date when delays occur
* Approve order changes, partial shipments and cancellations; ensure approvals are documented
* Ensure demo unit, spare parts and sample dispatches follow approved requests

**3. Export Documentation and Logistics**

* Review export documents before dispatch: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, CE certificate, conformity documents and partner-specific documents
* Approve freight forwarder and courier selection based on quotes, transit time and reliability
* Ensure dispatch intimation and tracking details reach the partner on dispatch day
* Resolve transit delays, damage and customs queries with the forwarder and partner
* Ensure statutory export records are complete: shipping bill, bank realization certificate, export incentive and duty claims

**4. Payment and Receivables Control**

* Ensure payments are tracked against agreed terms: advance and credit
* Review partner-wise receivables ageing weekly and report to the HoD
* Follow up personally on overdue accounts and recommend order hold where required
* Ensure invoices are closed after confirmed receipt and bank documents are filed

**5. Technical Support to Sales Partners**

* Resolve partner and end-user queries on ALAN electrosurgical generators and accessories: setup, operation, settings, compatibility and performance
* Diagnose reported faults and complaints with the partner, using photographs, videos and error details; guide corrective steps remotely
* Coordinate with service, QA and D&D when the issue needs repair, replacement or design review
* Ensure complaints, returns and replacements are logged, investigated and closed with recorded corrective action
* Identify repeat issues by product and partner; report patterns to QA and the HoD
* Support partner demos, product training and technical clarifications for tenders and registrations
* Maintain product technical documents, FAQs and troubleshooting guides for partner use

**6. Partner Records and Compliance**

* Ensure partner master data is current: agreements, validity, territory, price lists, registration documents and contacts
* Track expiry of agreements, product registrations and certificates; initiate renewals in advance
* Ensure authorization letters, declarations and tender documents requested by partners are issued on time

**7. Exhibitions, Conferences and ASPM**

* Represent ALAN at international exhibitions and conferences: booth operation, product presentation and partner meetings
* Plan events end to end: selection, registration, exhibit shipment and customs, travel, collaterals and budget
* Capture leads in a standard format; share the lead list and event report and track follow-up to closure
* Report event cost against leads generated and orders closed
* Plan and execute the Annual Sales & Service Partners Meeting (ASPM): venue and date finalisation, partner invitations and confirmations, agenda and speaker schedule, presentations, travel and logistics, budget and on-ground execution
* Set the ASPM timeline with owners and deadlines; track progress weekly and ensure every milestone is met on time
* Prepare the ASPM report with action points and track follow-up to closure

**8. Reporting, MIS and AOP**

* Review and submit weekly and monthly reports: orders booked, units and value by partner, backlog, dispatches against commitment, receivables ageing, open issues
* Report TAT adherence for order booking, dispatch and issue closure
* Consolidate partner target vs achievement and forecast updates
* Prepare and consolidate AOP data for international sales: partner-wise targets, achievement, forecast, orders and receivables
* Prepare the PPT for AOP meetings and present it, with data checked and ready before each meeting date
* Record AOP meeting decisions and action points; track closure with owners and deadlines

**9. Team Leadership and Process**

* Allocate work, set daily priorities, review output and coach the Executive and Junior Executive
* Assign an owner and a deadline to every task; maintain a team task tracker and review it daily
* Hold a weekly team review on pending items, delays and next week's priorities
* Ensure every activity in the order-to-payment cycle, AOP, ASPM and exhibition plans is completed within the defined timeline; follow up on delays and escalate to the HoD where required
* Set goals, review performance and give regular feedback to the Executive and Junior Executive; identify skill gaps and arrange training
* Document SOPs, checklists and templates for each step of the order-to-payment cycle
* Ensure continuity of order and partner support during travel and leave

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Order booking within TAT
* On-time dispatch against committed date
* Documentation error rate
* Technical issue closure within TAT; repeat issue rate
* Receivables outstanding beyond agreed terms
* Event leads converted to orders
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS
* Team task completion within deadline
* AOP data and PPT ready before meeting date
* ASPM milestones completed on schedule

**Required Qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Biomedical, Electronics or Electrical Engineering
* 8-12 years in international sales support, technical support or sales operations, with exposure to medical devices or capital equipment
* Technical understanding of electronic medical equipment: ability to read circuit-level and service documentation, diagnose faults and guide troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of export documentation, payment instruments and customs and shipping processes
* Hands-on experience with ERP/CRM and advanced Excel
* Strong written and spoken English; ability to handle international partner communication
* Ability to lead a team, deliver to deadlines and travel internationally

**Preferred**

* Direct experience with electrosurgical or similar surgical equipment
* Knowledge of product registration, ISO & CE-related documentation
* Exhibition or conference participation experience

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

DESCRIPTION  
In this role the Strategic Account Manager will manage a set of critical seller accounts which contribute to 20%+ business of the category. He/She will be responsible to develop strong relationships with top sellers in the category and drive improvements in customer facing inputs and achieve category objectives.  
  
Role and Responsibilities:  
  

* Managing the seller relationship by championing the seller’s needs at Amazon. Build strong communication channels at all levels of the seller’s organization, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan.
* Managing and driving the growth of the seller’s business: Build and execute on a strategic account plan that delivers on key business opportunities for the seller and Amazon.
* Managing key improvement initiatives and projects: Drive new product launches and relationship extensions by partnering with the business development and onboarding teams.
* Work with sellers to improve operational aspects of their business in providing a great consumer experience.
* Analyzing the business: Conduct deep dive analysis and provide routine executive-level reporting on the seller’s current business and future opportunities. Publish recommendations and action plans based on data.

  
A day in the life  
  
About the hiring group  
  
Job responsibilities  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own and manage a portfolio of high-value seller accounts contributing 20%+ of category business, driving revenue growth and category objectives through strategic account planning and execution.  
  
Build and nurture trusted relationships with top sellers across all organizational levels, serving as their primary advocate within Amazon while setting clear expectations and delivering proactive status communications.  
  
Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify and capitalize on key business opportunities for both the seller and Amazon, including new product launches and relationship extensions.  
  
Partner cross-functionally with business development, onboarding, and category teams to drive operational improvements that enhance the end-customer experience.  
  
Conduct deep-dive analysis on seller performance, market trends, and growth opportunities; deliver routine executive-level reporting with data-backed recommendations and actionable plans.  
  
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks in seller workflows, improving inputs such as selection, pricing, fulfillment speed, and catalog quality.  
  
Monitor key performance indicators and proactively course-correct to ensure sellers meet business targets aligned with category goals.  
  
A day in the life  
You start the day reviewing seller dashboards and key metrics to prioritize actions. Mornings are spent on calls with top sellers—resolving escalations, aligning on growth plans, and discussing new product launch timelines. You collaborate with cross-functional teams including business development, catalog, and operations to unblock seller issues and drive improvements. Afternoons involve deep-dive analysis, preparing executive reports, and refining account strategies. You balance relationship management with data-driven decision-making, ensuring your sellers deliver a great customer experience while hitting category targets.  
  
About the team  
The OHL team is focused on building and scaling Amazon's marketplace by partnering with the most impactful sellers in the category. We are a team of strategic thinkers and relationship builders who thrive on data-driven decision-making and operational excellence. Our mission is to deliver an exceptional customer experience by empowering top sellers to grow their business on Amazon. We work cross-functionally with business development, category, and operations teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where ownership and bias for action are at the core of everything we do.

------------------------

* 4+ years of sales or account management experience
* Experience successfully managing dynamic account portfolios
* Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
* Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
* Experience working cross functionally across several teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with and managing third party vendors, or experience in Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) or fulfillment operations

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Retail Trainer - Sales & Customer Experience
description:
**About Ugaoo**

Ugaoo is one of India's leading D2C gardening and home décor lifestyle brands, on a mission to make urban India greener. With a strong omnichannel presence across our website, app, marketplaces, quick commerce platforms, and an expanding network of retail stores, Ugaoo is redefining how customers discover and experience plants.

Our retail stores are designed to offer an immersive and memorable shopping experience. As we continue to expand across India, we are looking for a passionate Regional Trainer who can elevate customer interactions by building confident, customer-centric, and high-performing retail teams.

**Role Purpose**

The Regional Trainer will be responsible for enhancing the customer experience across Ugaoo's retail stores by developing frontline teams in selling skills, customer engagement, communication, grooming, and service excellence. The role will work closely with Retail Operations and HR to build a consistent service culture that reflects Ugaoo's brand values and drives higher customer satisfaction and sales performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Experience Excellence**

* Build a customer-first mindset across all retail stores by delivering training focused on exceptional service standards.
* Coach store teams on creating memorable customer interactions and delivering a premium shopping experience.
* Reinforce brand values and customer engagement behaviours through regular coaching and feedback.

**Sales & Selling Skills**

* Conduct training programs on consultative selling, need identification, cross-selling, upselling, objection handling, and closing techniques.
* Improve key retail productivity metrics such as conversion rate, average transaction value (ATV), and units per transaction (UPT).
* Coach employees to confidently engage with customers and build long-term relationships.

**Communication & Soft Skills**

* Develop employees' verbal and non-verbal communication skills.
* Conduct workshops on active listening, customer conversations, empathy, conflict resolution, and handling difficult customer situations.
* Enhance employee confidence and professionalism in customer-facing interactions.

**Grooming & Professional Etiquette**

* Drive grooming standards, personal presentation, body language, and workplace etiquette across stores.
* Ensure consistent adherence to Ugaoo's retail appearance and behavioural standards.

**Store Coaching & Field Training**

* Conduct regular store visits to observe employee interactions and provide on-the-job coaching.
* Work closely with Store Managers to identify behavioural skill gaps and recommend development interventions.
* Provide structured feedback and action plans for continuous improvement.

**Learning Content & Training Delivery**

* Design and deliver engaging classroom, virtual, and experiential learning sessions.
* Develop training modules, role plays, case studies, learning aids, and assessment tools focused on customer experience and sales excellence.
* Continuously refresh content based on business needs and customer feedback.

**Performance Measurement**

* Evaluate training effectiveness through observations, customer feedback, mystery audits, assessments, and business metrics.
* Maintain training records, learning dashboards, and monthly training reports.
* Recommend capability-building initiatives based on performance trends.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Retail Operations, HR, and Store Managers to identify capability gaps and execute development plans.
* Support customer experience initiatives and service improvement programs across the retail network.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Customer Experience (CSAT/NPS)
* Mystery Audit Scores
* Sales Conversion Rate
* Average Transaction Value (ATV)
* Units Per Transaction (UPT)
* Customer Feedback Ratings
* Training Coverage & Completion
* Behavioural Assessment Scores
* Store Service Standard Compliance

**Qualifications**

  

* Graduate in any discipline; certification in Learning & Development, Hospitality, or Retail Training is preferred.
* 5–8 years of experience in Retail Training, Customer Experience, Hospitality, or Sales Training.
* Experience in lifestyle retail, fashion, beauty, hospitality, premium retail, or D2C brands will be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned regions.

**Key Skills**

* Customer Experience Training
* Sales & Selling Skills Coaching
* Communication & Presentation Skills
* Behavioural & Soft Skills Training
* Grooming & Professional Etiquette
* Facilitation & Adult Learning
* Coaching & Feedback
* Stakeholder Management
* Training Content Development
* Performance Analysis

**Why Join Ugaoo?**

* Be part of one of India's fastest-growing D2C lifestyle brands.
* Shape the customer experience across Ugaoo's expanding retail network.
* Work in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment with cross-functional teams.
* Play a key role in building a service culture that differentiates Ugaoo's retail experience.

**Department:** Procurement / Purchase  
**Job Title:** Procurement Executive  
**Experience:** 2–5 years (preferred)

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded, and result-oriented Procurement Executive who can manage the complete purchasing process efficiently, from identifying requirements and sourcing suppliers to negotiating prices, coordinating deliveries, and ensuring timely availability of materials.

The ideal candidate will understand that procurement is not just about placing purchase orders. It is about **getting the right quality, at the right price, from the right supplier, at the right time**—while protecting the company's cost, quality standards, and business interests.

We need someone who takes ownership, thinks ahead, solves problems independently, and follows every purchase until closure.

Key Responsibilities1. Sourcing & Vendor Management

* Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers and alternative vendor sources.
* Obtain and compare quotations from multiple vendors to ensure competitive pricing.
* Negotiate prices, payment terms, credit periods, delivery schedules, warranties, and other commercial terms.
* Build long-term vendor relationships while maintaining healthy commercial competition.
* Maintain an updated vendor database with pricing, lead times, capabilities, and performance records.

2. Purchase Planning & Execution

* Understand internal purchase requirements and convert them into timely purchase actions.
* Raise and manage purchase orders with accurate specifications, quantities, rates, and delivery terms.
* Ensure materials, products, or services are procured as per approved requirements and budgets.
* Follow up proactively with vendors to ensure on-time delivery.
* Coordinate with internal departments to avoid shortages, delays, and unnecessary purchases.
* Track pending purchase orders and maintain clear visibility of expected deliveries.

3. Cost Control & Commercial Negotiation

* Identify opportunities for cost savings without compromising quality or delivery.
* Compare quotations on a total-cost basis, including freight, taxes, payment terms, and other applicable charges.
* Challenge unreasonable price increases and negotiate improved commercial terms.
* Maintain historical price records and monitor market price movements.
* Identify opportunities for bulk purchasing, better payment terms, and alternative sourcing where commercially beneficial.

4. Quality, Delivery & Problem-Solving

* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve quality issues, shortages, incorrect supplies, and delivery delays.
* Ensure purchased items meet approved specifications and quality requirements.
* Escalate critical supply risks early and propose practical alternatives.
* Coordinate replacement, return, warranty, and claim processes whenever required.
* Take responsibility for closing procurement issues rather than simply forwarding them to others.

5. Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of quotations, comparative statements, purchase orders, invoices, delivery documents, and vendor communications.
* Ensure purchases follow company approval processes and procurement policies.
* Track purchase costs, savings, delivery performance, pending orders, and supplier issues.
* Prepare regular procurement reports and maintain transparent documentation for management review.

6. Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with operations, finance, stores, production, sales, or other relevant departments to understand requirements.
* Coordinate with the accounts team regarding invoice discrepancies, payment terms, and vendor payments.
* Ensure purchasing decisions support business priorities, working capital discipline, and operational continuity.

The Ideal Candidate We Want

We are looking for someone who:

* **Has a cost-conscious mindset:** Always looks for better value instead of blindly accepting the first quotation.
* **Is a strong negotiator:** Can communicate confidently with vendors and secure commercially favourable terms.
* **Takes ownership:** Follows up independently and ensures every purchase reaches closure.
* **Thinks ahead:** Anticipates shortages, price changes, delivery risks, and supplier issues before they become serious problems.
* **Is proactive, not reactive:** Does not wait for repeated reminders from management to complete routine responsibilities.
* **Is detail-oriented:** Checks specifications, quantities, rates, taxes, delivery terms, and documentation carefully.
* **Makes decisions using facts:** Compares quotations, historical prices, quality, reliability, and total cost before recommending a supplier.
* **Communicates professionally:** Can handle vendors firmly and respectfully while maintaining good business relationships.
* **Is honest and commercially ethical:** Maintains transparency in vendor selection, negotiations, approvals, and purchasing decisions.
* **Is comfortable with accountability:** Can explain purchasing decisions, savings achieved, delays encountered, and corrective actions taken.

Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or vendor management.
* Good knowledge of quotation comparison, purchase orders, commercial negotiations, and vendor follow-ups.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including quotation comparisons, price tracking, and purchase reports.
* Working knowledge of ERP or purchase management systems is an advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prioritise multiple requirements and work with minimal supervision.

Performance Expectations (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be assessed on:

* Cost savings and measurable commercial improvements.
* On-time delivery and timely closure of purchase requirements.
* Quality and reliability of selected vendors.
* Reduction in avoidable emergency purchases and supply disruptions.
* Accuracy of purchase orders and procurement documentation.
* Vendor responsiveness and resolution of procurement issues.
* Compliance with approved budgets, policies, and authorisation procedures.

Who Should Not Apply?

This role may not be suitable for someone who:

* Only collects quotations and places orders without analysing them.
* Accepts vendor pricing without attempting negotiation.
* Requires constant reminders to follow up on pending purchases.
* Blames suppliers or internal teams instead of finding solutions.
* Focuses only on the lowest price while ignoring quality, reliability, and total cost.
* Is careless with documentation, specifications, or commercial terms.
* Is unwilling to take responsibility for decisions and outcomes.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity for a procurement professional who wants to take ownership, improve purchasing efficiency, build strong supplier relationships, and make a measurable contribution to business performance.

We value people who combine integrity, commercial intelligence, execution discipline, and a problem-solving mindset.

**Our expectation is simple: We need someone who does not merely purchase what is requested, but actively protects the company's cost, quality, time, and business interests.**

title: General Manager
description:
Vaisala is a global leader in measurement instruments and intelligence helping industries, nations, people, and the planet to thrive. From predicting hurricanes to optimizing renewable energy production, our technology is used where it matters the most – from data centers, windfarms and laboratories to airports, the Arctic and even the surface of Mars. For a second year running, Vaisala got recognized in TIME Magazine's World's Best Companies in Sustainable Growth 2026 study. Our team of close to 2,500 experts and 62 nationalities around the world is committed to taking every measure for the planet. Driven by our shared purpose, curiosity, and pioneering spirit, we stay ahead and make a difference. At Vaisala, you don't have to fit in to belong.

**General Manager India**

The General Manager position in our India office is accountable for the overall commercial performance, strategic market development, customer engagement, and organizational leadership of the Vaisala Industrial Measurements business in India, driving profitable growth and strengthening Vaisala's market position in one of the company's most important growth markets.

**Main responsibilities**

Your key responsibilities include:

* Lead and manage Vaisala’s Industrial Measurements India organization including
  

* + Develop and execute the India growth strategy aligned with APAC and Vaisala Industrial Measurements business priorities
  + Own and deliver India Industrial Measurements sales targets, orders intake, revenue, profitability, and market share objectives
  + Drive sales excellence through opportunity management, forecasting accuracy, and disciplined CRM (salesforce) utilization
  + Lead strategic account planning and executive-level customer engagement.
  + Uphold the company’s performance standards for the team through active performance based measurement and line management.
  + Provide guidance for day to day operations for the India Sales activities including logistics, Human resources and finance.
  + Promote the Vaisala ways of working and culture

* Market Development and Strategy including
  + Identify emerging market opportunities, industry trends, and strategic growth segments within India
  + Develop country-specific go-to-market plans to accelerate growth in both direct and indirect sales channels
  + Strengthen Vaisala's market positioning and brand presence through customer engagement, industry associations, and key events.
  + Defining and agreeing on marketing actions with marketing and business management.
  + Monitor competitor activities and provide actionable market intelligence to regional and global leadership.

* Customer and Partner Management including
  + Establish and maintain strong relationships with key customers, decision-makers, EPCs, consultants, OEMs, and strategic partners and integrators.
  + Actively participate in customer activities including meeting with existing and potential customers and channel partners, follow-up of opportunities, guiding and reviewing prospects.
  + Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and long-term customer retention.
  + Lead negotiations for major commercial opportunities and strategic contracts.
  + Drive distributor and channel partner performance, capability development, and growth initiatives.

* Cross Functional Collaborations
  + Collaborate closely with Marketing, Service, Product Management, Human Resources, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver business results.
  + Act as the primary India representative within the APAC Industrial Measurements leadership team.
  + Support implementation of regional and global strategic initiatives within the Indian market.

* Financial & Operational Management
  + Own sales forecasting, business planning, and budget management for India.
  + Prepare, follow-up and report the progress of annual plan. This includes defining key activities, market estimates, competition analysis, staffing requirements and marketing & expense budget for the area. Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions where necessary.
  + Ensure compliance with company policies, governance standards, and ethical business practices.
  + Competence management. Maintain and enhance team’s expertise and knowledge of company's offering and trade skills. Develop practices for both direct customer contact and channel management, supported by utilization of modern marketing tools.

* Channel Partner Development and Management which includes
  + Working with and managing channels to ensure performance targets are achieved.
  + Developing marketing campaigns jointly with distributors
  + Analyzing new markets and seeking out suitable distributor candidates.
  + Organizing regular distributor trainings to ensure product knowledge stays up to date.
  + Supporting channels on opportunities by providing timely response to technical queries
  + Joint customer visits with distributors.

**What should the ideal person reach in 6 months and 24 months after employment?**

**6 months:**

* Strong familiarity with Vaisala’s Industrial Measurement’s offering
* Successfully built working relationships with our current channel partners.
* Successfully built working relationships with our key integrator and OEM customers.
* Evaluate and present a detail country strategy and plan to achieve to the target
* Identified key focus areas for Indian market
  

**12-24****months:**

* Within first 12 months, evaluate and present a detail country strategy and plan to achieve the targets set up under the India Business Plan.
* Strong market knowledge with networks across key focus industries of Semiconductors, Lithium Ion Battery, Data Centers, Life Sciences and Power. This could mean networking with end users, EPCs, PMCs and relevant integrators.
* Clarity on channel partner network and successful establishment of the partner network in each state.
  

**How is the selected person's performance assessed?**

Performance evaluation:

* Orders intake and revenue growth
* Gross margin and profitability
* Forecast accuracy
* Pipeline coverage and conversion rates
* Strategic account growth
* Customer satisfaction/NPS
* Market share development
* Team engagement and capability growth
* Distributor performance and channel growth
  

**Qualifications of the ideal candidate**

* You are an ideal candidate for this role if you have strong experience in leading high performing product/system team(s) in Vaisala. Managing an office requires a solid hands on attitude as well as excellent collaboration and problem solving skills. When leading a team and working within a global matrix organization it´s vital to have excellent people leadership, strategic thinking, solid planning and execution skills as well as great communication and negotiation skills.
* We value a person that is dynamic, active and inspires teams to work towards common goals.
* You also have solid understanding of modern IT tools, channel development and digital marketing. As a person you have a continuous development mindset as well as genuine drive to develop business, people and organisation and desire to make success within Vaisala
* Curiosity and a growth mindset to explore, learn, and apply AI tools in your daily work. We expect everyone at Vaisala to actively discover how AI can enhance their work
  

**Education**

An academic degree preferably a Masters level degree in industrial technologies or business management.

  

**Work experience**

Preferably 10 years of relevant experience in a relevant leadership role

  

**Language skills**

You have great communication and presentation skills in English.

* Continuously expand your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to enhance your performance.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

Our India Sales Development team is where Workday's growth story begins. We build relationships grounded in integrity, collaboration, and transparency, and we're the first touchpoint connecting organisations across India to the next era of digital innovation in HR and Finance. As part of this team, you'll work alongside people who genuinely care about each other's success and who believe that doing great work and having a great time doing it go hand in hand.

**About the Role**

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative, you'll be the engine that fuels our pipeline, turning curiosity into qualified opportunities that move Workday's story forward. You'll partner closely with Account Executives and regional Marketing to make sure every prospect conversation counts, and you'll be a trusted voice to prospects navigating what's possible with Workday.

In this role, you will:

* Deliver qualified opportunities for progression into Stage 1 pipeline
* Work closely with Account Executives on account engagement plans to maximise account coverage
* Collaborate closely with regional Marketing teams on campaigns and provide closed-loop feedback
* Generate high-value activity daily to engage new prospects and follow up on leads
* Conduct research to understand industry and business drivers as part of your outbound plan
* Qualify accounts and leads to understand pain points, compelling events, timelines, and decision makers
* Communicate at a professional level to engage effectively with C-suite executives
* Clearly articulate the value of Workday's solutions
* Use available tools (Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.) to power your prospecting activities
* Maintain excellent Salesforce hygiene, keeping activities and notes updated in a timely way

And what do we offer you? A clear career path with structured learning and development, a rewarding compensation package, and a diverse, dedicated team that supports one another every step of the way.

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* **Sales Acumen:** 2+ years of proven experience in an inbound and/or outbound sales development (SDR/BDR) role, with a track record of consistently achieving and exceeding targets.
* **Strategic Judgment:** Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, resolve issues, and make strategic recommendations for prospective customers.

**Other Qualifications**

* **Pipeline Builder:** Skilled at identifying leads, nurturing relationships, and converting them into qualified opportunities that drive sustained revenue growth.
* **Natural Relationship Builder:** You excel at making sincere, meaningful connections quickly. You earn trust through consistency and honesty, and you aren't shy about engaging with people across different backgrounds and locations.
* **Clear Communicator:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. You can comfortably adapt your style for different audiences and facilitate clear, effective conversations with senior stakeholders.
* **Value-Driven Mindset:** Comfortable uncovering customer needs and clearly articulating how Workday’s solutions deliver real business value.
* **Strong Business Acumen:** You stay current on market trends and industry dynamics, using those insights to make informed decisions and drive smarter outreach.
* **Exceptional Work Ethic & Resilience:** You are self-motivated, driven, and hungry for success. You consistently achieve goals over time through perseverance, resilience, and effective time management.
* **Natural Leader:** You don't wait for permission to act. Whether you've led sports teams, held leadership roles in academia, or initiated movements, you instinctively lead from the front.
* **Values Alignment:** You believe that success and integrity are partners. You naturally align with Workday's core values, guiding your daily interactions with mutual respect, unwavering trust, and a collaborative spirit.

  

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

description:
**SOVOS**

**Salesforce Application Architect**
====================================

Accounting/Finance·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity.
* Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales.
* Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access.
* Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder.
* Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy.
* Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design.
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios.
* Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer.
* Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale.
* Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance.
* Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**THE PROCESS**

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

**1**

**Pre-Employment Assessment**

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

**2**

**Video Interview**

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

**4**

**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

**LIFE AT SOVOS**

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy

We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

title: Cloud Sales Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and

Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate

cloud, data and AI transformation.

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led

business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate

within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units,

hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organisations.

The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity

orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer

conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler

capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.

The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organisational boundaries,

influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud

technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation
* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed

sales/revenue targets.

* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP opportunities.

  

* Client Engagement & Consultative Selling
* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive-level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.

* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner
* Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU sales teams across NTT DATA.

Key responsibilities include:

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and

strategy.

* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer engagements.
* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.

  

* Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement
* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives

and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.

* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and

hyperscaler platforms.

* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.

  

* Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership
* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition,

stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.

* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
Drive opportunities from initial qualification solution shaping proposal

negotiation closure.

C. Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with customers and technical stakeholders across:

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS

  

* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.

**7. Internal Orchestration**
=============================

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities, bringing together:

Client Manager BU Cloud Specialist Presales/Solution Architecture Delivery Hyperscaler Commercial/Finance

Responsibilities include:

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.

Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.

Required Qualifications:

* 8–10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.
* Experience in a Systems Integrator, IT Services company, hyperscaler or technology

consulting organisation preferred.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.

Technical & Business Skills

Strong understanding of:

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services

* Cloud security
* Digital transformation

Sales Competencies

* Consultative / value-based selling
* Enterprise account planning
* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation
* Executive stakeholder management
* Deal shaping and negotiation
* Partner ecosystem management
* Forecasting
* Cross-functional influence
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**Workplace type****:**

  

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

title: Fixed Income Derivatives Sales Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Support EMEA Fixed Income Derivatives Sales with pricing, structuring, analytics, and client materials; automate workflows

As a Fixed Income Derivatives Sales Analyst within the EMEA Sales team (Markets Group, CIB Research & Analytics) you will be responsible for supporting sales coverage through interest rate hedging and derivatives solutions for corporate clients. You will structure and price vanilla and bespoke derivatives using internal models, run analytics, and quantify key market and credit risks. You will work on trade ideas and client-ready strategies by synthesizing macro drivers and internal/external research and analysing payoff profiles for client objectives. You will create tailored client materials (pitchbooks, factsheets, and market analysis) and articulate product rationale in the current environment. You will support end-to-end trade execution and lifecycle processes while driving automation and process improvements using Python/VBA.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support Fixed Income Derivatives sales/marketing coverage by understanding client objectives and identifying suitable interest rate hedging and derivatives solutions for corporate clients
* Structure and price derivative solutions (vanilla and bespoke) using internal flow pricing models and by combining option strategies, and run relevant analytics to support pricing metrics and quantify market/credit risks
* Generate trade ideas and client-ready strategies by synthesizing macroeconomic drivers and external/internal research, and optimizing payoff profiles for the target client base
* Create client materials for meetings including tailored pitchbooks/factsheets and market analysis, articulate product rationale for the current environment and backtest strategy outcomes where applicable
* Manage end-to-end trade support across the lifecycle including instrument setup/creation, booking support, term sheet preparation, note issuance coordination, and responding to post-trade client queries (settlements, lifecycle calculations, reconciliations, and documentation checks)
* Drive process improvement and automation for the sales team by building tools to streamline recurring workflows and daily tasks using Python/VBA

**Required Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:**

* Strong knowledge of derivatives and greeks – indices, futures, and options
* Strong knowledge of Equities, Rates, FX, and Commodities
* Knowledge of VBA and any object-oriented programming language (specifically Python)
* Close attention to detail and ability to work at very high standards of precision
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with Strong quantitative and analytical skills
* Good communication and team skills in a multi-location set up

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:**

* Clear, logical thinker with strong qualitative skill set
* Strong team player that partners well with stakeholders

title: Sales Executive
description:
Industry - Education

Working Days - Monday to Saturday

Location - Marine Lines

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Identify loan need** Work with counsellors to flag students likely to need funding at the counselling stage, not after the offer letter. The earlier a **early** case starts, the higher the chance the student actually flies.

**Assess and match** Understand the student's profile — course, university, country, co-applicant income, collateral available, existing obligations — and match to lenders realistically likely to sanction. Secured versus unsecured, margin money, moratorium terms, processing fees, rate of interest.

**Present real** Give every student a written comparison of at least two suitable lenders, showing rate, tenure, margin, collateral requirement **options** and total cost. The student chooses. You advise.

**Manage** Own the file: KYC, academic records, income proof, collateral documents, offer letter. Most rejections and delays are **documentation** documentation failures. Preventing them is the job.

**Drive to** Track every case from application through sanction to actual disbursement. A sanction that never disburses is not a result. **disbursement** Chase lenders, chase students, chase valuers.

**Handle rejections** Where a case is declined, understand exactly why and reposition it with a different lender or a restructured application. Do not return a student to their counsellor with a no and nothing else.

**Deliver partner** Know where each lending partner stands against expected volume. Maintain working relationships with partner relationship **commitments** managers.

**CRM and reporting** Every case logged and staged accurately. Weekly Excel reporting on pipeline, sanction rate, disbursement value, turnaround time and partner-wise split — built and maintained by you.

**HOW WE ADVISE ON LENDERS**

**The student's cost of borrowing comes first.** Recommend based on what the student can realistically get and what it will cost them over the life of the loan — not on our commercial arrangement with any lender. Every student is shown a comparison of at least two options in writing, and is told plainly that we have a commercial relationship with its lending partners. Any pressure to steer a student towards a more expensive product should be escalated immediately.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Must have**

* 2–4 years in education loans, retail lending, banking, NBFC or DSA sales, with targets attached.
* Working knowledge of secured and unsecured education loans: co- applicant assessment, collateral, margin money, moratorium, sanction and disbursement process.
* Genuinely customer-centric. Families are anxious and often financially stretched — how you handle that conversation matters. Confident on a CRM and disciplined about keeping it current.
* Strong Excel: pivot tables, lookups, filters, building a report from raw data without help.
* Operations experience — you have run a documentation-heavy process end to end. Clear spoken and written English. Comfortable on the phone all day.

**Nice to have**

* Study-abroad or overseas education background.
* Existing relationships with education lenders.
* Exposure to international lenders for US, UK, Canada or Australia. Additional Indian languages.
